methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to create a new stocktake (inventory count) in draft status. For non-manual scopes, the product list is automatically populated based on the selected scope and warehouse.

parameters.name: warehouse_id
parameters.documented_description: Warehouse identifier. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the method getInventoryWarehouses.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.documented_description: Stocktake scope defining which products are included: 0 - all products, 1 - manual product selection, 3 - specific warehouse zones, 4 - specific location prefixes, 5 - random product selection

parameters.name: name
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Stocktake name/description

parameters.name: priority
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Priority: 0 - low (default), 1 - medium, 2 - high, 3 - urgent

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Assigned employee identifier

parameters.name: date_scheduled
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Execution scheduled date (unix timestamp)

parameters.name: date_due
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Execution due date (unix timestamp). Must be later than or equal to date_scheduled.

parameters.name: approval_method
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Approval method: "immediate" (default) - stocktake is completed immediately after counting, "confirm" - requires secondary approval step after counting

parameters.name: blind_count
parameters.documented_description: (optional) If true, hides the expected quantity from the counter. Default: false

parameters.name: confirm_location
parameters.documented_description: (optional) If true, forces the user to scan/confirm the location before counting. Default: false

parameters.name: allow_add_remove_items
parameters.documented_description: (optional) If true, allows adding or removing products during the counting phase. Default: false. Always true for manual scope.

parameters.name: product_ids
parameters.documented_description: (optional) List of simple product or variant identifiers to include. Required when scope is 1 (manual).

parameters.name: scope_zones
parameters.documented_description: (optional) List of warehouse zone identifiers. Required when scope is 3 (zones).

parameters.name: scope_locations_prefix
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Semicolon-separated location name prefixes to filter by. Required when scope is 4 (locations). Example: "A-1;B-2"

parameters.name: scope_random_count
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Number of random products to select. Required when scope is 5 (random). Must be a positive integer.

cross_field_constraints.source_text: Must be later than or equal to date_scheduled.

methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to retrieve a paginated list of stocktakes from BaseLinker storage. It supports filtering by stocktake, warehouse, status, series, number, and creation date range.
